runtime_style.visual_system: A low-sun forest fashion story moves between dark woodland, green duckweed water, extreme-low portraits, sculptural full figures, authored reflections and wide environmental surrender.
runtime_style.mood_line: Dreamlike but optically clean: the face remains quiet while off-axis joints, water and a near-black forest carry the drama.
runtime_style.environment: A generic temperate woodland edge and adjacent still water with grass and leaf litter, pale birch and dark trunks, dense shaded undergrowth, green duckweed, breaks of open water, bright foliage and visible cool sky.
runtime_style.lighting: One low warm sun appears as direct face or cloth patches, hair rim or background burn depending on camera position; cool open sky provides the shaded fill and direct-versus-shaded face remains shot-specific.
materials: dark fissured and pale birch bark
grass, leaf litter and shaded undergrowth
dense matte duckweed and still reflective water
wet cloth with clinging vertical folds and duckweed specks
one small handheld reflective surface used only in its detail direction
runtime_style.contrast: Strong depth contrast from near-black woodland mid-planes against white cloth, warm sun patches, green water and occasional blue sky; highlights retain cloth and skin texture without bloom.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Brows and cheeks rest, lids are low or fully closed, mouths are relaxed closed or slightly parted, and direct gaze is allowed only without smile or facial performance.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Dry cloth hangs by gravity in gathers and broad slow folds with little wind; wet cloth darkens, clings in vertical wrinkles, becomes partly translucent at contact and carries duckweed flecks.
optical_signature: Clean rendering with no authored flare shape, veiling glow, bloom, halation, vignette, chromatic fringe or swirl.
Close portraits use rapid smooth focus falloff, while full-length and wide environmental frames retain progressively more spatial detail.
Low camera height, water-level reflection, elevated water view and connected foreground limbs are shot-specific camera devices rather than one stacked effect.
Blue sky and white cloth keep texture and colour separation; no fake diffusion is added around highlights.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Use the source-observed vertical low-angle medium portrait: camera below chest height looking upward, with the visible face above the shoulder line and dark softened trees behind.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Keep the torso long, lift both arms into an asymmetrical overhead and behind-head chain, let shoulders stay down, carry lids low and hold the mouth neutral without copying any source facial geometry.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Place critical focus on the approved subject's near eye and sunlit face plane; let the tree background fall away smoothly while cloth texture stays readable.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: Keep the frame clean except for connected upper arms near the edges; no water reflection, compact, detached hand or veil crosses the approved face.
provenance: frame-04.jpg: low-angle medium portrait, direct low-sun face patch, raised sculptural arms, low lids and dark tree bokeh

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Use a level vertical full-length frame from roughly waist-to-chest height and preserve a much larger forest field around the person, including uneven ground and dark trunk depth.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Plant one foot while the other crosses or lightens, push the pelvis slightly one way and counter-lean the torso, bend both elbows into unequal angles and let wrists drop without athletic tension.
environmental_hero.focus: Keep the complete approved person and immediate ground readable while the darkest mid-plane separates the silhouette and the far foliage softens.
environmental_hero.foreground: Allow a narrow grass or leaf-litter ground band only; nothing may cover the approved item, feet, hands or face.
provenance: frame-05.jpg: full-length shaded forest stance with large dark environment, angular elbows, limp wrists and off-camera gaze
frame-06.jpg: distinct side-lean, hip counterbalance and lens-directed variant

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Frame vertically from head through lower torso or thigh with substantial negative dark woodland around the figure; stay near chest height rather than repeating the low identity camera.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Arch the upper torso, take both arms behind the body, release the head back and then tilt it off the body axis so throat and shoulder line form the principal geometry.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Hold face, neck, shoulder and near cloth on one readable plane; let the surrounding forest become a broad dark field with a controlled direct-sun patch.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: No separate foreground device; the body silhouette and negative woodland must remain uninterrupted.
provenance: frame-09.jpg: environmental three-quarter arch, head dropped and tilted, arms behind, direct sun patch and dark forest negative space

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Move to a horizontal waterline close portrait and divide the composition between the upright approved face above and one physically coherent inverted water reflection below.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Keep shoulders low in the water, turn the head only slightly, open one eye toward the lens or close both without tension, and let wet cloth settle against the body.
interference_frame.focus: Prioritise the approved eye and facial plane while retaining enough reflected facial structure to read as water; keep the distant pond soft.
interference_frame.foreground: Still water and its duckweed edge are the only interference layer; do not add double exposure, glass, fog, compact mirror or extra optical distortion.
provenance: frame-08.jpg: upright face in the upper field, inverted water reflection below, wet cloth, duckweed edge and warm reflected sky

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Use a vertical torso/detail crop with a small approved reflective accessory enlarged in the lower foreground and the real body receding behind it.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Connect the holding hand anatomically to a relaxed arm, keep fingers separated around the accessory edge and leave shoulders quiet; no detached hand or duplicated limb.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Place the sharp plane on the single upside-down reflection and accessory edge while allowing the real torso and face behind to fall deliberately soft.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The one handheld reflective surface owns the lower foreground; no water reflection, near forearm wall or secondary prop is added.
provenance: frame-02.jpg: compact or mirror dominates lower foreground, reflected face is sharp and the real white-clothed body is soft

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Use a horizontal elevated wide above the pond so duckweed, open dark water and one fallen birch diagonal occupy more area than the approved person.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Let the body float or rest supine on a diagonal, arms open with soft elbows and relaxed fingers, chest lifted only by buoyancy and head rolled upward rather than posed toward a portrait camera.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Retain the person, nearby duckweed boundary and fallen trunk as readable environmental planes without portrait-style background obliteration.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: The water surface fills the frame; preserve one open-water break and one fallen birch crossing, with no invented shoreline architecture or extra props.
provenance: frame-07.jpg: elevated wide supine water composition, open arms, duckweed/open-water pattern and diagonal fallen birch
